Exercise Objective: Develop strength, stability, and balance in the muscles of the pelvic, abdominal, back, and shoulder areas

## Start Position

1. Start on elbows and knees on a non-slip surface
2. Elbows should be directly under shoulders and knees should be directly under hips
3. Head remains in a neutral position to keep the body in line

## Procedure
